transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what brings me in is... my eating has just gotten really out of hand lately. 

Especially after my late shifts. I'll stop for takeout on the way home and end up eating two burgers, fries, a shake... and then I'll still get home and just clean out whatever leftovers we have in the garage fridge. It's, uh, it's like I'm having a whole second supper right after the first one.
When that eating happens, does it feel like you can’t stop or control how much you’re eating?

Yeah, that's exactly it. Once I start, it just... it feels like a switch is flipped. Even while I’m sitting there telling myself, 'Roy, shut the bag and go inside,' my hands just keep reaching for more. I really can't seem to stop once I get going.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit to try to undo them?
No, I don't do that. I mean, I feel pretty miserable and stuffed afterwards, but I've never tried to make myself throw up or anything like that.
When this happens, do you eat much more food than most people would eat in a similar amount of time?

Yeah, I'd definitely say so. Like I was mentioning a minute ago with the two burgers and the fries, and then all those leftovers... I mean, that's a lot of food for one sitting. Most guys on my shift might grab a burger on the way home, but they aren't eating a massive takeout meal and then walking in the door to eat a whole second supper right on top of it. So yeah, it's definitely way more than what's normal for that short of a time.
Do these eating episodes upset you a lot?

Yeah, they really do. Afterward, I just... I feel ashamed, honestly. Kind of disgusted with myself. I've always thought of myself as a disciplined, dependable guy, you know? I go to work, do my job... but this? It makes me feel like I'm sneaking around, like I'm just letting myself down every time it happens.
How often do these eating episodes happen?

Well, for the past few months, I'd say there's usually at least one night a week where I end up doing this. Often it's more like two or three nights, honestly. It mostly happens after a late shift, or just... if it's been a really rough day on the line.
For how long have these binge-eating episodes been happening at least once a week?
It's been going on for about five months now. It started right around the time they put me in the acting lead role on the CNC line at work.
